card.name: Scattered small words and digits in drug lists
card.fires_on: No single word or setting. It fires on small pieces such as a digit inside a year, an opening parenthesis, 'as', 'with', 'or' or 'oral' in lists and names.

modes.label: Digits and brackets in names
modes.description: Part of a number or an opening bracket inside a year or chemical name.

modes.label: Linking words in lists
modes.description: Small words like with, or, oral within lists of conditions or vaccines.
